Two Delivery Firms Now Operating as One

The combination of Alderton Delivery Services and Halstead Transport is complete, and one operation now handles the scheduled deliveries and pickups that the two companies previously carried out separately for business customers in the nine districts they both served.

Performers to appear in Woodgate Square
Four spaces have been set aside for licensed acts.
By Miriam Whitaker, March 12
Street performers will appear in Woodgate Square this spring under a new program run by the Woodgate Square Management Office. Counts taken last summer showed that the number of people in Woodgate Square fell by nearly half after the lunch hour. "Store owners nearby reported slow afternoon trade," said Miguel Ocampo of the office. Organizers say the shows should draw shoppers into the smaller streets behind the square.
Acts are grouped by category, and only one act from each category performs in a block. "The program is approved for one season only," Mr. Ocampo added. "If audiences grow, we will propose a second year." Allocations and conditions appear on the office's space allocation page.

Around the City
Performers to appear in Woodgate Square
Four spaces have been set aside for licensed acts.
By Miriam Whitaker, March 12
Street performers will appear in Woodgate Square this spring under a new program run by the Woodgate Square Management Office. Counts taken last summer showed that the number of people in Woodgate Square fell by nearly half after the lunch hour. "Store owners nearby reported slow afternoon trade," said Miguel Ocampo of the office. Organizers say the shows should draw shoppers into the smaller streets behind the square.
Acts are grouped by category, and only one act from each category performs in a block. "The program is approved for one season only," Mr. Ocampo added. "If audiences grow, we will propose a second year." Allocations and conditions appear on the office's space allocation page.

She said that items needing workshop attention are picked up once a week, on Thursday, so mine would wait until then. I leave on July 12 and do not want to travel with taped frames. Has anyone found a quicker route?
Y. P.
----------------------

For customers, effective from June 1.
An item left for workshop attention is entered on a record card at the counter and held in the store until the weekly transfer round. The case and the original receipt are not needed.

A customer who needs an item sooner than that may ask, before that store's transfer day, for it to be sent to the Lowden Street store by next-day courier. An extra charge applies.
